name: MonarchMegaMenu
title: MegaMenu
summary: Site navigation with large groups as a list that expands in place, for a navigation drawer or a full-height sheet: each entry opens headed groups of links with icons, badges and descriptions, and a featured card.
whenToUse: In the navigation drawer or menu sheet of a signed-out area (a product site, a help centre) whose sections each hold several destinations.
whenNotToUse: For the top-level destinations of a signed-in app, use a NavigationBar, NavigationRail or NavigationSuiteScaffold. For a short list of actions, use MonarchMenu.
api: @Composable fun MonarchMegaMenu(items: List<MonarchMegaMenuItem>, expandedItem: String?, onExpandedItemChange: (String?) -> Unit, onNavigate: (String) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, labels: MonarchMegaMenuLabels = MonarchMegaMenuLabels())
class MonarchMegaMenuItem(id: String, label: String, link: String? = null, sections: List<MonarchMegaMenuSection> = emptyList(), featured: MonarchMegaMenuFeatured? = null)
class MonarchMegaMenuSection(heading: String?, links: List<MonarchMegaMenuLink>, description: String? = null)
class MonarchMegaMenuLink(label: String, link: String, description: String? = null, badge: String? = null, external: Boolean = false, icon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null)

class MonarchMegaMenuFeatured(title: String, link: String, description: String? = null, badge: String? = null, actionLabel: String? = null, external: Boolean = false, icon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null)
class MonarchMegaMenuLabels(expanded: String? = null, collapsed: String? = null, explore: String? = null, external: String? = null)

options.name: items
options.description: The top-level entries: a direct link, or sections and a featured card.

options.name: expandedItem
options.description: The id of the expanded entry, or null.

options.name: onExpandedItemChange
options.description: Called with the id to expand, or null to collapse.

options.name: onNavigate
options.description: Called with the link of the destination the user taps.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for "Expanded", "Collapsed", "Explore" and "Opens outside the app".

states.name: collapsed
states.description: Each entry is a row with a down chevron.

states.name: expanded
states.description: The entry's row takes the subtle fill and an up chevron; its groups and featured card are shown below it.

states.name: external link
states.description: An open-outside mark after the label, and TalkBack adds "Opens outside the app".

appearance: Rows use the default text, group headings the muted caption in capitals, descriptions the muted caption. Link icons sit on a subtle accent tile in the strong accent. The featured card is the subtle background with a subtle border. Badges use the accent tone. The same roles apply in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web MegaMenu is a horizontal bar whose entries open wide panels on hover or click. A phone has no hover and no room for wide panels, so on Android the menu is a vertical list that expands one entry in place, the pattern of a navigation drawer. The web's openOnHover has no equivalent. Links are app-defined strings passed to onNavigate; the component does not open URLs.
accessibility: Each entry is a button with a touch target of at least 48dp; an expandable entry reads "Expanded" or "Collapsed".
Each link is one button read as its label, badge and description; an external link adds "Opens outside the app".
Group headings are headings, read in the case they were given.
Icons and chevrons are not read.
Expanding animates with the theme motion, and is immediate when animations are off.
edgeCases: Only one entry is expanded at a time.
An entry with neither a link nor sections does nothing when tapped.

examples.title: Product site header
examples.setup:
var expanded by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>("product") }
var page by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
examples.code:
MonarchMegaMenu(
    items = listOf(
        MonarchMegaMenuItem(
            id = "product",
            label = "Product",
            sections = listOf(
                MonarchMegaMenuSection(
                    heading = "Plan",
                    links = listOf(
                        MonarchMegaMenuLink(
                            label = "Projects",
                            link = "projects",
                            description = "Track work from idea to launch",
                            icon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Grid, contentDescription = null, size = MonarchIconSize.Sm) },
                        ),
                        MonarchMegaMenuLink(
                            label = "Calendar",
                            link = "calendar",
                            description = "Deadlines and milestones in one view",
                            badge = "New",
                            icon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Calendar, contentDescription = null, size = MonarchIconSize.Sm) },
                        ),
                    ),
                ),
                MonarchMegaMenuSection(
                    heading = "Collaborate",
                    links = listOf(
                        MonarchMegaMenuLink(
                            label = "Teams",
                            link = "teams",
                            description = "Roles, access and ownership",
                            icon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Users, contentDescription = null, size = MonarchIconSize.Sm) },
                        ),
                        MonarchMegaMenuLink(
                            label = "Settings",
                            link = "settings",
                            description = "Workspace preferences",
                            icon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Settings, contentDescription = null, size = MonarchIconSize.Sm) },
                        ),
                    ),
                ),
            ),
            featured = MonarchMegaMenuFeatured(
                title = "What changed this month",
                link = "changelog",
                description = "A short tour of the newest features and fixes.",
                badge = "Updated",
                icon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Grid, contentDescription = null, size = MonarchIconSize.Sm) },
            ),
        ),
        MonarchMegaMenuItem(
            id = "company",
            label = "Company",
            sections = listOf(
                MonarchMegaMenuSection(
                    heading = "About",
                    links = listOf(
                        MonarchMegaMenuLink(label = "Who we are", link = "about", description = "The team and how we work"),
                        MonarchMegaMenuLink(
                            label = "Status",
                            link = "https://status.example.com",
                            description = "Service health",
                            external = true,
                        ),
                    ),
                ),
            ),
        ),
        MonarchMegaMenuItem(id = "support", label = "Support", link = "support"),
    ),
    expandedItem = expanded,
    onExpandedItemChange = { expanded = it },
    onNavigate = { page = it },
)
